name: Ie ni Dareka Iru
source:
When you get home from work one day, you see a strange creature standing in the middle of your room.
With your junior colleague deciding to come by, who was chased out of his own place for "reasons," the three of you start living together in this bizarre slice-of-life.

[From [url=https://fuyuki1032.itch.io/theres-someone-in-my-house]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一天，当你下班回家时，你看到一个奇怪的生物站在你的房间中央。
你的初级同事决定过来，他因“原因”被赶出自己的住所，你们三个开始一起生活在这个奇怪的生活片段中。

[来自[url=https://fuyuki1032.itch.io/theres-someone-in-my-house]Itch.io[/url]]
